title: Share your live location
text: Before a late trip, share your live location with someone you trust using WhatsApp or Google Maps.

title: Check the cab before you sit
text: Match the number plate and driver with the app, and send the trip details to a friend or family member.

title: Choose busy, well-lit routes
text: Avoid empty shortcuts at night. Keep your phone charged before you leave.

title: Keep your profiles private
text: Set social media accounts to private and only accept people you actually know.

title: Never share OTPs or passwords
text: No bank, company or friend needs your OTP. Do not share personal photos or your live location with strangers.

title: Save proof, then report
text: Take screenshots of harassing messages, block the person, and report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

title: Keep a record
text: Write down the date, time and details of any harassment, and save messages or emails.

title: Know your rights
text: Workplaces with 10 or more employees must have an Internal Committee to handle sexual harassment complaints.

title: Tell someone you trust
text: Talk to a colleague, friend or family member early. You do not have to handle it alone.

title: Save emergency numbers
text: Keep 112, 1091 and 181 saved in your phone, and make sure family members know them too.

title: Check before opening the door
text: Look through the peephole or ask for identity proof from delivery or service visitors you do not know.

title: Keep important papers safe
text: Keep copies of ID, phone numbers and documents with a trusted person, in case you need to leave quickly.
